gate.title: Section gate

gate.adminTagline: Audit access is logged. Only super-admins hold the section password.

error.unavailable: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a few minutes.

login.hero: A learning system designed for the long road from Leh to Drass.
login.intro: Goldenmile RTT — Refresher Teacher Training — supports teachers and mentor pairings across Leh and Kargil, with WhatsApp-first video review and a paperwork system that respects how schools actually run.
login.confidential: Confidential · internal programme use only · audited
login.instructions: Use the credentials your programme administrator gave you.
login.instructionsWithEmail: Use the credentials your programme administrator gave you, or request a sign-in link by email.
login.mobileTagline: Sign in to keep teaching. Works on patchy network — your session is cached locally.
